params.name: filter[date_eq]
params.description: Exact date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Required if `filter[symbol]` is not present.

params.name: filter[date_from]
params.description: Start date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

params.name: filter[date_to]
params.description: End date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

params.name: filter[symbol]
params.description: Ticker symbol (e.g., 'AAPL.US'). When provided, `filter[date_eq]` may be omitted.

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Number of records per page (1-10000).

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: Pagination offset (0-1000000).

params.name: fmt
params.description: Output format. Defaults to 'json'.

items.docs:
Look up upcoming and historical dividend events.

Uses the JSON:API filter/page convention. **At least one of `filter[date_eq]` or `filter[symbol]` is required** — a request without either will return HTTP 422.

params.name: api_token
params.description: Your API token for accessing the API.

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for earnings data, in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Defaults to today if not provided.

params.name: to
params.description: End date for earnings data, in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Defaults to 7 days from today if not provided.

params.name: symbols
params.description: Specific symbols to retrieve earnings data for, separated by commas (e.g., 'AAPL.US,MSFT.US'). Overrides the 'from' and 'to' parameters if used.

params.name: fmt
params.description: Output format, either 'csv' or 'json'. Defaults to 'csv'.

items.docs: Fetches upcoming earnings data, with optional parameters for date ranges and specific symbols.
